Subject: Need help with a consumer complaint case

Hello, my name is Mohan Sandhu. I am a 62-year-old electrician living in Chennai. I paid Goyal Developers ₹3,26,00,000 for a flat, and the builder keeps promising possession by email but never delivers. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 06926818780 or email mohan.sandhu@example.com.
